intro: Winterhoof Cleansing is a rite entrusted to Horde adventurers by Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. After goblin operations fouled the local springs, a consecrated totem must be carried into the Venture Company's territory to purify the Winterhoof Water Well. Restoring this spring is a vital first step in healing the poisoned waters of central Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!
This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not delay, friend Highcloud. The Winterhoof Well's taint must be removed!

clips.title: Completion
paras: News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.
You have done a great thing for the land, friend Highcloud. And you have done a great thing for the traveler people.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
